topic: Week 2 recap: 6 more Claude lessons for beginners in 60 seconds
post:
Two weeks of learning Claude, still no tech background needed. 🎓
Here's everything from week 2, in 60 seconds.

1️⃣ What's an AI agent?
A chatbot answers. An agent plans, acts, checks its work, and asks you before big decisions.

2️⃣ Notes in, slides out
Hand Claude Cowork your messy notes and ask for a first-draft deck.

3️⃣ Plan mode in Claude Code
See the plan before anything changes. Nothing is edited until you approve.

4️⃣ The "write in my voice" prompt
Show Claude 2 examples of your writing instead of describing your style.

5️⃣ Connectors
Link Claude to apps like your calendar and email, so you stop copy-pasting.

6️⃣ One giant chat
New topic, new chat. Carry over a short summary, not the whole history.

Why it matters:
Week 1 was about clear instructions. Week 2 was about letting Claude DO more, while you stay in control. 🧭

Your challenge for next week: try one lesson you skipped.

Which lesson was most useful for you? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
